title: Handling of the periodic registration update timer and mobile reachable timer

entities.name: Periodic registration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure used over 3GPP access to periodically notify UE availability to the network. Controlled by timer T3512 in the UE.

entities.name: Periodic registration update timer T3512
entities.description: Timer controlling periodic registration updates in UE. Value sent in REGISTRATION ACCEPT message. Only applies to 3GPP access.

entities.name: Mobile reachable timer
entities.description: Network timer supervising UE periodic registration. Typically 4 minutes longer than T3512 for non-emergency services.

entities.name: Implicit de-registration timer (3GPP access)
entities.description: AMF timer controlling when UE is considered implicitly de-registered over 3GPP access. Default 4 minutes longer than T3512.

entities.name: Non-3GPP implicit de-registration timer
entities.description: AMF timer controlling when UE is considered implicitly de-registered over non-3GPP access. Longer than non-3GPP de-registration timer.

entities.name: Non-3GPP de-registration timer
entities.description: UE timer controlling when UE considers itself implicitly de-registered for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: UE state where periodic registration update procedure is initiated when T3512 expires.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: UE state where T3512 is stopped (unless strictly periodic timer supported).

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
entities.description: State entered when implicit de-registration timers expire.

entities.name: UE registered for emergency services
entities.description: Condition affecting timer behavior - UE does not perform periodic registration when T3512 expires, but locally de-registers.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
entities.description: Message that carries T3512 timer value from network to UE.

entities.name: MICO indication IE
entities.description: Information element indicating whether strictly periodic registration timer is supported.

relations.description: Periodic registration update procedure is controlled by timer T3512
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains T3512 timer value
Periodic registration update procedure is initiated when UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode and T3512 expires
T3512 is stopped when UE enters 5GMM-CONNECTED mode (unless strictly periodic timer supported)
T3512 is stopped when UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
UE does not perform periodic registration update when registered for emergency services
MICO indication IE determines whether T3512 is stopped/reset during state transitions
Mobile reachable timer expiry starts implicit de-registration timer over 3GPP access
Non-3GPP implicit de-registration timer expiry causes UE to enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
Non-3GPP de-registration timer expiry causes UE to enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
